verdict.rationale: GrowthBook documents a full REST API for driving the application (features, experiments, etc.) with an SDK Connection Endpoint and public/authenticated access patterns, plus an official MCP server that wraps this REST API with agent skills/guardrails, giving AI-native users a documented programmatic and agentic entry point. missing for 10: a discoverable OpenAPI/Swagger spec (probe found 404s on standard OpenAPI paths) and independent hands-on confirmation of API robustness beyond docs.
